summary: Production data: 8-15% of unenforced structured outputs are recoverable-malformed (fenced/mislabeled JSON, displaced sentinel, trailing commas, CoT preamble). Today these cost a correction round or a whole cycle. A deterministic Go salvage pass in deliverable.Verify — lenient, LOGGED, bounded (never invents values) — converts them to zero-cost saves identically across all four CLIs, with zero constraint tax.
